scenes.title: Where and when
narration: Starotikveško is a traditional Macedonian folk dance (oro) originating from the Tikveš region, an area located in the central part of North Macedonia.

The dance was documented in detail by researcher Mihailo Dimovski in the 1977 publication Macedonian folk dances (Македонски народни ора), published in Skopje by Naša kniga and the Institut za folklor.

scenes.title: Watch it
narration: The dance is traditionally performed by men and is structured into five distinct parts that accelerate from slow to fast dancing.
The dancers begin positioned in a half circle while holding each other by the shoulders.
As the dance develops, they release the shoulder grip to dance with loose hands.
Watch for Shoulder-hold half circle, Single-file circle transition.
